blocks.raw: # Getting Started with the Payment Initiation Service
blocks.text: Getting Started with the Payment Initiation Service

blocks.raw: The Payment Initiation Service can be used to initiate [Single Immediate Payments](https://modulr.readme.io/docs/single-immediate-payments-overview) or to initiate [Fixed Recurring Payments (Standing Orders).](https://modulr.readme.io/docs/fixed-recurring-payments-standing-order-overview)
blocks.text: The Payment Initiation Service can be used to initiate Single Immediate Payments or to initiate Fixed Recurring Payments (Standing Orders).

blocks.raw: This functionality can be integrated into your own app, website or using a URL link sent directly to end users.
